# 2.39:1 letterbox on the motion promo

The motion-graphics promo with a 2.39:1 cinema matte: black bars top and bottom turn the 16:9 frame into a widescreen look without re-rendering or cropping the picture underneath.

- Type: Letterbox matte
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `matte`
- Output: 1920x1080, 12 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/f09-letterbox.mp4`](../videos/f09-letterbox.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Give the Magnifito motion promo (../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4) a cinematic widescreen feel: add black 2.39:1 letterbox bars over the full 12 seconds, keep the 1920x1080 frame, and save it as work/letterbox.mp4.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f09-letterbox
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f09-letterbox/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo matte ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 --preset 2.39:1 --color black --out work/letterbox.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/letterbox.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
